player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} tan gaganapen nen Pig Dice.

Sarayan:
- Diad say turn mo, pwede ka '[roll]' o '[hold]'
- Roll 2-6: Dakel say turn total mo
- Roll 1: Nawala turn total mo ken pinatey turn mo
- Hold: Dakel say turn total mo ken score mo ken pinatey turn mo
- Say umuna nakala {winning_score} puntos so nanalo

No say turn mo, makita mo say kasalanan scores ken turn total.
Sagot ka '[roll]' a roll die o '[hold]' a banken puntos mo.

board.current_total_scores: Say Total ya Punto ed Natan: {scores} say total na turn mo natan et {turn_total}.

outcome.winner_by_score: Say Managpapat {winner_id} ya managpapanao lapud inabot so target score na {winning_score}!
outcome.draw: Akasabi la so limitasyon na saray turn tan amin a manlalaban et walaan lay parehon score: {scores}
